rows.title: Equestrian Training Academy in Public Schools – Riyadh
rows.description: This opportunity sets up an Equestrian Training Academy inside public schools in the Riyadh region. It will build and run riding arenas, stables, and training programs for 250–400 trainees each year. Location: Al Iskan district, Riyadh city, on a site of more than 12,000 m², using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education. It is the first academy of its kind inside a public school, helping promote horse riding as part of Saudi heritage.

rows.title: Investing in Sports Facilities in Public Schools – Jeddah
rows.description: This opportunity invests in and manages school sports facilities in Jeddah. It improves facility quality, encourages sports for everyone, and helps find and develop new talent, supporting the goals of the Quality of Life Program and the Ministry of Sports. Location: 6th Elementary Model School, Jeddah, on a 1,250 m² site. The project will build and run football fields, courts, and fitness areas, using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education.

rows.title: Investing in Sports Facilities in Public Schools – Dammam
rows.description: This opportunity invests in and manages school sports facilities in Dammam. It improves facility quality, encourages sports for everyone, and helps find and develop new talent, supporting the goals of the Quality of Life Program and the Ministry of Sports. Location: Prince Mohammed bin Fahd Education Complex, Dammam, on a 3,000 m² site. The project will build and run football fields, courts, fitness areas, and multi-purpose sports spaces, using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education.

rows.title: Investing in Sports Facilities in Public Schools – Riyadh
rows.description: This opportunity invests in and manages school sports facilities in Riyadh. It improves facility quality, encourages sports for everyone, and helps find and develop new talent, supporting the goals of the Quality of Life Program and the Ministry of Sports. Location: Mujahid Bin Jabr Elementary School, Riyadh, on a 2,200 m² site. The project will build and run football fields, courts, and fitness areas, using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education.

rows.title: CRO capacity
rows.description: Establishment of CRO capabilities including drug discovery services and the running of preclinical studies and human clinical trials.

rows.title: CAR-T cell therapeutics
rows.description: Development of CAR-T cell therapeutics through investments in R&D.

rows.title: Innovative cell therapy R&D & commercialization
rows.description: Establish a research center for cell therapies developed from various cell platforms including stem cells, tumor infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL), natural killer (NK) cells and dendritic (DC) cells.

rows.title: Longevity & wellness ‘omics
rows.description: Investment in the space of longevity therapeutics and omics data, utilizing local infrastructure and data availability.

rows.title: Longevity therapeutics
rows.description: Investment in the space of longevity therapeutics, utilizing local infrastructure and data availability.

rows.title: Gene therapy R&D & commercialization
rows.description: Development of research facilities specialized in gene therapy, as well as investing in commercialization capabilities for gene therapies.

rows.title: Clinical / commercial C&GT production
rows.description: Establish an offering within cell and gene therapy (e.g. CAR T-cell), particularly focusing on rare diseases, infectious diseases and oncology.

rows.title: Peptide DS manufacturing
rows.description: Localize production of peptides from cell lines by setting up local production facilities.

rows.title: Recombinant protein DS manufacturing
rows.description: Establishing recombinant protein drug substance manufacturing, including fusion proteins and formulation.

rows.title: Monoclonal antibody DS manufacturing
rows.description: Establishing monoclonal antibody drug substance manufacturing, including antibody-drug conjugates and formulation

rows.title: Innovative vaccine R&D capacity
rows.description: Build a viral vector and nucleic acid vaccine-dedicated R&D infrastructure focused on cutting-edge technologies. Innovative vaccine technologies include mRNA, p-DNA and viral vectors.

rows.title: Bio-based construction materials development
rows.description: Development of R&D facilities and pilot plants for production of bio-based construction materials (e.g., bio-cement)

rows.title: Cosmetic active development
rows.description: Opportunity to invest in R&D and production facilities to develop more efficient and bio-driven production processes of active ingredients for cosmetics and personal care to leverage more stable and sustainable sources

rows.title: Nutraceuticals ingredient development & production
rows.description: Opportunity to invest in nutraceuticals ingredient development and fermentation-based production (e.g., of vitamins, amino acids, carotenoids, probiotics) used in functional foods and dietary supplements

rows.title: Biological wastewater treatment development
rows.description: Development of biological wastewater treatment plants, e.g., facilities leveraging anaerobic or aerobic microorganisms to decompose contaminants in industrial or domestic wastewater, or bioremediation for e.g., oil, mining industries, recultivating land, etc.

rows.title: Cross-category industrial enzyme development
rows.description: Opportunity to build a local technological platform within industrial enzymes by developing leading R&D, IP, manufacturing, and application infrastructure to unlock R&D synergies across end markets

rows.title: Alternative feedstocks development
rows.description: Build R&D facilities and pilot plants for algae or carbon-based production processes (e.g., laboratory for strain selection, plantation for cultivation, pre-processing facilities and refineries) to develop alternative feedstock for production of e.g., biofuels as well as adjacent use for wastewater treatment

rows.title: Biological waste-to-bioenergy facility development
rows.description: Development of biological waste-to-bioenergy plants converting waste (e.g., municipal solid waste, industrial waste, agricultural waste) to biogas, biofuels, etc. through microbial digestion or fermentation to divert waste streams from landfills and generate energy.

rows.title: Synthetic biology R&D
rows.description: Invest in R&D infrastructure to facilitate multidisciplinary synthetic biology research and attract MNCs alongside technology startups to leverage local research capabilities

rows.title: Biopolymer development and production
rows.description: Investment in specialized biopolymer production plants (e.g., PLA, PHA, poly-ethylene) or retrofit of plants to integrate bio-naphtha as feedstock, with adjacent R&D plants to drive development and commercialization of bio-based and biodegradable polymers and achieve price parity with traditional polymers.

rows.title: Alternative protein development and production
rows.description: Alternative protein development and production through e.g., CDMO-operated bioreactor plants for fermentation-based and cell cultured meats.

rows.title: Biocontrol development & production
rows.description: Establishing production facilities for manufacturing biopesticides, by cultivating and processing the natural sources from which biopesticides are derived, and establishing R&D to optimize formulations for local pest profiles and challenges

rows.title: Biostimulants development & production
rows.description: Establishing production facilities for biostimulants, including the sourcing and processing of raw materials, manufacturing, and formulation development optimized for specific crops and local soil conditions

rows.title: AMBULANCE
rows.description: Localization of manufacturing of repurposing kit and assembly of Ambulances in KSA

rows.title: Compost Production Facility
rows.description: Develop composting facilities to treat 300K tons/year of agricultural waste.

rows.title: Livestock Breeding and Fattening
rows.description: Invest in large state of the art commercial livestock farms, focusing on the optimal breeds i.e., Al-Naimi sheep (Awassi), Najdi, Harri, Dorber, Merino and Holstein cows

rows.title: Integrated Potato Play
rows.description: Invest in an integrated potato facility, farming optimal breeds (e.g., Hermes, Spunta, Desiree, Elite, and Super Elite, hybrid) to produce fresh whole potatoes as well as frozen and value-added potato products (e.g., chips)

rows.title: Safe storage in Riyadh
rows.description: A secure storage and high-value goods warehouse in Riyadh, serving luxury retailers, jewelry traders, galleries, e-commerce sellers, and high-value importers. The facility will provide private vaults, safe cages, secure inventory rooms, climate-controlled storage, insured handling, chain-of-custody tracking, packing / dispatch support, and secure pickup / delivery across Riyadh

rows.title: Safe storage in Jeddah
rows.description: A secure storage and high-value goods warehouse in Jeddah, serving luxury retailers, jewelry traders, galleries, e-commerce sellers, and high-value importers. The facility will provide private vaults, safe cages, secure inventory rooms, climate-controlled storage, insured handling, chain-of-custody tracking, packing / dispatch support, and secure pickup / delivery across Jeddah and the Western Region.

rows.title: Private aviation facilities in RUH, Malham & MED
rows.description: Development and operation of private aviation facilities, including Fixed Base Operations (FBO), aircraft hangars, MRO workshops, and VIP passenger terminals, across three strategically chosen Saudi airports serving Riyadh (primary business hub), Malham (dedicated GA node), and Madinah (high-value pilgrimage & VIP corridor). The platform captures demand from Saudi-based HNWI owners, corporate flight departments, and international charter operators

rows.title: Development of aircraft spare parts manufacturing industry
rows.description: Establish a KSA-based aircraft spare parts manufacturing and localization platform focused on high-recurring, non-critical and certifiable aircraft components identified from airline Required Spare Parts Lists. The opportunity targets selected parts with recurring fleet demand, high import dependency, and manageable certification requirements, serving Saudi and GCC airlines, MRO operators, and aviation suppliers

rows.title: Relocation of regional hubs for e‑commerce and Courier Express Parcel (CEP)
rows.description: Attract freight forwarders, 3PLs, e-commerce platforms, fulfillment operators, and CEP players to relocate regional logistics hubs to Saudi Arabia, anchored around Riyadh Integrated / SILZ. The opportunity targets bonded warehousing, air-freight transfer, cross-docking, fulfillment, sortation, returns processing, inventory buffering, and GCC distribution

rows.title: Set up a GSE leasing and managed fleet platform for major KSA airports
rows.description: Establish a specialized GSE leasing and managed fleet platform that procures new ground support equipment from OEMs, leases it to ground handlers, airlines, cargo handlers, FBOs and airport operators, and provides maintenance, telematics, spare-unit pooling and eGSE transition support. Selective sale-and-leaseback transactions can be used to secure anchor customers and recycle capital from existing operator-owned fleets

rows.title: Chartered jets and fractional ownership services operator
rows.description: Establish a Saudi-based private aviation operator offering on-demand jet charter, fractional ownership, jet cards, aircraft management, and premium flight support. The opportunity targets corporate executives, UHNWI / HNWI travelers, family offices, major events, luxury tourism destinations, and business delegations across high-growth nodes in the Kingdom

rows.title: Aircraft Disassembly, Dismantling & Recycling
rows.description: A dedicated aircraft end-of-life (EOL) facility in KSA offering full-spectrum disassembly, component harvesting (Used Serviceable Materials / USM), material recycling, and hazardous waste management — targeting Saudi, GCC, and wider Middle East airlines undergoing rapid fleet renewal, while positioning KSA as the region's first AFRA-accredited teardown hub.

rows.title: Development of aircraft refitting industry
rows.description: Establish a KSA-based aircraft refitting facility offering cabin reconfiguration, avionics modernization, passenger-to-freighter (P2F) conversion support, and VVIP completions, serving Saudi, GCC and wider MENA commercial carriers, cargo operators, lessors, business aviation operators, and government / royal fleets

rows.title: Food security terminal in Yanbu
rows.description: Development of a multi-commodity food security terminal at Yanbu’s Red Sea gateway, combining dry-bulk silos, ambient and temperature-controlled storage, food-grade liquid tanks, QC / inspection facilities, customs-enabled handling, redistribution, and optional re-export for strategic food commodities. The terminal will support grains, rice, sugar, edible oils, feed inputs, chilled / frozen foods, and packaged staples, strengthening Saudi Arabia’s strategic food reserves, import resilience, and western-region food distribution.

rows.title: Attract logistics firms to support the oil and gas industry at SPARK
rows.description: Develop and lease 49,000 sqm of bonded warehouse space at SPARK for oil and gas logistics tenants, including equipment suppliers, spare-parts distributors, maintenance firms, and specialist storage operators. The platform is supported by SPARK’s dry port, customs access, and energy-sector ecosystem, with future upside from tenant-led tank-container, bulk-storage, maintenance, and hazmat BTS facilities

rows.title: Automotive Logistics Park – SPARK
rows.description: An integrated automotive‑led logistics platform supporting vehicle import, bonded storage, PDI, and handling, complemented by spare parts warehousing, refurbishment, and GCC distribution/re‑export. The facility also enables bonded light assembly and servicing, and supports dedicated heavy equipment assembly and logistics (e.g., cranes, loaders), leveraging SPARK’s industrial ecosystem.

rows.title: Development of marinas to support yachting and leisure vessels in Saudi Arabia
rows.description: Develop a network of modern marinas across Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea and Arabian Gulf coasts, serving premium yachting, leisure boating, chartering, water sports, and coastal tourism. The opportunity will combine marina infrastructure, berthing, dry storage, fuel, utilities, maintenance, F&B/retail, and visitor services to activate coastal destinations and build a scalable marine-tourism ecosystem

rows.title: Development of Jubail freight station
rows.description: Develop a rail-linked freight station in Jubail to serve industrial cargo, port flows, and regional distribution. The facility will combine rail terminal yards, cross-dock, warehousing, truck staging, cargo handling, and value-added logistics services, supporting Jubail’s role as an integrated industrial and logistics hub

rows.title: Development of the eastern entrance truck stop – Riyadh
rows.description: Operation of a full-service truck stop at Riyadh's eastern entrance on the Riyadh–Dammam highway, providing full services such as fueling, parking, maintenance, F&B, and driver accommodation to commercial vehicles serving the Kingdom's most active long-haul route and GCC cross-border traffic

rows.title: Expansion of logistics and industrial zones around King Abdullah Port
rows.description: Expansion of port-adjacent logistics and industrial zones around King Abdullah Port within KAEC, positioning the site as a Red Sea resilience platform for bonded warehousing, re-export, light manufacturing, automotive logistics, cold chain, and supply-chain continuity

rows.title: Jadidat Arar Cross-Border Logistics Center
rows.description: A cross-border logistics center at Jadidat Arar serving Saudi–Iraq trade flows, exporters, importers, industrial distributors, food and FMCG suppliers, building-material traders, 3PLs, customs brokers, and regional re-export operators. The center will provide truck staging, customs-ready storage, bonded / controlled warehousing where licensed, cross-docking, inspection areas, value-added services, documentation support, and dispatch to Iraq and Northern Saudi corridors

rows.title: Multi-Modal Logistics Hub in Yanbu
rows.description: A multi-modal logistics hub in Yanbu Industrial City serving agriculture / food, chemicals, metals, minerals, and building-material flows across Madinah, Qassim, the Western Region, and export / re-export markets. The hub will provide rail-linked container handling, export and re-export zones, warehouses, bulk and breakbulk yards, value-added handling, customs-linked storage, and road / rail / port dispatch

rows.title: Development of Dammam Regional Logistics Center
rows.description: A large-scale regional logistics center in Dammam serving agriculture / food, chemicals, metals, and building-material flows across Eastern Province, Riyadh, Jubail, and GCC markets. The center will provide bulk and breakbulk yards, general and specialized warehousing, consolidation, customs-ready storage, value-added handling, multimodal transfer, and road / rail dispatch, leveraging Dammam’s port gateway role and future Land Bridge connectivity

rows.title: Micro-Fulfillment Hubs in Riyadh and Jeddah
rows.description: A network of urban micro-fulfillment hubs in Riyadh and Jeddah, designed to support fast-moving e-commerce, grocery, retail, FMCG, pharmacy. The hubs will provide compact Grade-A fulfillment space, ambient and temperature-controlled storage, picking / packing, rider staging, inventory pooling, returns handling, and last-mile dispatch to reduce delivery times and improve service reliability

rows.title: Peri-Urban Distripark in Al-Ahsa
rows.description: A peri-urban distripark in Al Ahsa serving food & beverage, agriculture, agri-inputs, and regional food distribution. The zone will provide cold and dry storage, farm-gate aggregation, sorting, grading, packing, labeling, cross-docking, inventory pooling, and regional dispatch for farms, food processors, wholesalers, retailers, HORECA suppliers, and 3PL operators across Al Ahsa, Eastern Province, Riyadh, and GCC corridors.

rows.title: Railway spare parts manufacturing and localization
rows.description: Manufacturing and localization of certified railway spare parts, consumables, and track components in Saudi Arabia, targeting recurring replacement demand from SAR, metro operators, HSR systems, rail MRO providers, and adjacent industrial sectors. Initial products comprise prioritized opportunities for localization, including brake shoes, filter elements, springs, relief valve, wear plate, cable, machine banks, crossing helix, hoses, and battery storage

rows.title: Industrial Valley Logistics Lands for Clean Industries in KAEC
rows.description: Serviced industrial and logistics land offerings within KAEC Industrial Valley and SEZ, positioned for clean and light industries such as FMCG, pharmaceuticals, building materials, automotive, packaging, and logistics services. Providing serviced plots through long-term lease or freehold ownership, enabling investor-led development of manufacturing, storage, and distribution facilities near King Abdullah Port

rows.title: Pre-Built warehouses units for logistic use (KAEC)
rows.description: A pre‑built logistics warehouse development comprising 12 connected core‑and‑shell units, offered for sale and dedicated exclusively to logistics use. Each unit includes approximately 1,000 sqm of open yard space and a 115 sqm mezzanine floor. The development is strategically located near King Abdullah Port, enabling efficient port‑linked logistics operations and supporting demand from import, export, and regional distribution activities, with the possibility to convert them to bonded warehouses if needed

rows.title: Integrated DG & Chemical Logistics Park in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City
rows.description: A specialized Chemical & Dangerous Goods logistics park in Jeddah 3rd Industrial City, providing DG-compliant storage, cargo yards, tank / ISO handling, chemical distribution, and export / re-export staging. The park will serve chemical producers, plastics / rubber manufacturers, specialty-material importers, industrial tenants, and DG logistics operators.

rows.title: Pilgrimage & Hospitality Supply Chain Center in Madinah’s Industrial City
rows.description: A logistics hub for food, hygiene, and hospitality goods serving hotels, hospitals, and religious facilities across Madinah. The center will provide integrated cold and dry storage for pilgrimage and tourism operations, ensuring supply reliability and supporting the city’s role as a northern logistics gateway

rows.title: Integrated DG & Chemical Logistics Park in Dammam’s 3rd Industrial City
rows.description: A specialized logistics park providing DG-compliant storage, tank handling, and chemical distribution for Dammam’s and Jubail’s industrial base. The facility will serve as a secure inland consolidation point for chemical exports and inbound feedstock, enabling safer operations and attracting global DG logistics operators

rows.title: Bonded & Re-Export Logistics Zone in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City
rows.description: A dedicated bonded and re-export logistics zone in Jeddah 3rd Industrial City, combining bonded yards, warehouses, staging areas, and value-added logistics services. The zone will serve chemicals, metals, F&B, industrial tenants, importers, exporters, and re-export players, leveraging internal demand from Jeddah 3rd IC tenants and proximity to Jeddah Islamic Port.

rows.title: Bonded & Re-Export Zone in Dammam’s 3rd Industrial City
rows.description: A dedicated bonded and re-export logistics zone in Dammam 3rd Industrial City, supporting importers, exporters, industrial tenants, machinery / MRO players, petrochemical-linked traders, e-commerce distributors, and regional re-export operators. The zone will provide bonded yards, bonded warehousing, customs-linked storage, value-added services, consolidation, and redistribution, leveraging Dammam’s port, rail, industrial, and Gulf connectivity.

rows.title: Agro-Food & Edible Oils Export Cluster in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City
rows.description: An integrated agro-food and edible oils export cluster in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City, supporting food processors, edible oils / fats producers, packaging players, ingredients suppliers, and export-oriented F&B manufacturers. The cluster will provide processing-ready plots, cold and dry storage, packaging / labeling, quality-control support, export staging, and port-linked logistics to serve domestic, GCC, Red Sea, African, and wider international markets

rows.title: Cold Chain & Food Park in Makkah 2nd Industrial City
rows.description: A temperature‑controlled logistics park supporting food storage, light processing (packing and portioning), and distribution for the Hajj and Umrah ecosystem and retailers in the Western Region, enabling consolidated cold and ambient flows, seasonal surge capacity, reduced spoilage, and lower logistics costs with reliable peak‑period service for catering operators and organized retail chains (modern supermarkets and hypermarkets).

rows.title: Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA)
rows.description: Opportunity to develop Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA) production facility of ~10 KTA in KSA to cater regional and global demand

rows.title: Adipic Acid
rows.description: Opportunity to develop Adipic Acid production facility of ~150 KTA in KSA to cater regional and global demand

rows.title: Tankers and Offshore Support Vessels Manufacturing
Drilling Mud Manufacturing Facility
rows.description: Establish a drilling mud manufacturing facility to serve local and regional oil & gas demand

rows.title: Directional Drilling Machines Assembly Plant
rows.description: Set up a directional drilling machines (Mud Motor & RSS) assembly plant to serve local and regional demand

rows.title: Water quality monitoring and control
rows.description: The investment entails the installation, operation, and maintenance of water quality monitoring

increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide


of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)


reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries


transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Yanbu Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Yanbu are additional demand 
drivers and are projected to increase in the future


competitiveness in the economy are further drivers 
for formulation of the opportunity

rows.title: Manufacturing Of Mechanical Seals For Industrial Equipment
rows.description: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of mechanical seals for industrial equipment to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.Overall demand for mechanical seals in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated to be 19,000 units in 2017. Driven by upcoming energy projects by Saudi Aramco, SEC and SWCC, demand is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 6.1% to reach 30,300 units by 2025. Currently, KSA demand for mechanical seals for industrial equipment is addressed mainly domestically; however, the remaining 30% is addressed through imports, presenting a great opportunity for investors to localize production.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the larger regional market in the GCC. With a growing demand in the region for high-quality mechanical seals used in oil and gas, water and wastewater, and power projects, the demand in the rest of the GCC is expected to increase from 29,000 units in 2017 to 45,000 units by 2025.In addition to an increasing market demand, Saudi Arabia has competitive costs for materials, labor and logistics and offers funding and incentives to investors.The main focus of this opportunity is to establish a manufacturing facility for mechanical seals for industrial equipment.Manufacturing: establish mechanical seals manufacturing facility to fabricate seals components, the facility to include turning, boring, grooving, milling, drilling and tapping capabilitiesFinishing operations: establish workshops to deliver hard facing, grinding, lapping, polishing and welding capabilities in addition to advanced surface treatment proceduresHowever, additional opportunities for localization exist across the value chain of mechanical seals production. These opportunities include:Design: establish a design and engineering capabilitiesInput materials: establish local foundriesInstallation and maintenance: offer support services, including quality control, assembly, and installation servicesInstallation and maintenance: offer maintenance services and repair services for mechanical seals and installed base

rows.title: Manufacturing Of Circuit Breakers
rows.description: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of circuit breakers to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.The overall demand for circuit breakers in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated at USD 370 million in 2018. Driven by utilities, oil and gas and other manufacturing industries, KSA demand is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 4% to reach USD 439 million by 2022. In 2018, demand for circuit breakers is 60% for high voltage and 30% for low voltage and ~10% for medium voltage. The split is expected to remain relatively the same till 2022.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the large regional market in the GCC with expected increase in demand from USD 308 million in 2018 to USD 370 million by 2022.The focus of this opportunity is on final manufacturing and components manufacturing of circuit breakers. These opportunities entail:Components manufacturing: establish manufacturing facilities conductors, contacts, operating mechanism and enclosuresFinal manufacturing and testing: establish facilities for final manufacturing of low circuit breakersFinal manufacturing and testing: establish facilities for final manufacturing of medium voltage circuit breakersFinal manufacturing and testing: establish world scale testing facilities for (e.g., vacuum interrupter predictive testing)However, there are additional opportunities across the circuit breakers manufacturing value chain. Opportunities include:Design: custom design and engineer circuit breakers for low and medium voltage applications for Saudi customersInput materials: manufacture copper alloys to meet KSA's specifications

rows.title: Manufacturing Of Industrial Gears
rows.description: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of gears for industrial machinery to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.The overall demand for industrial gears in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated at USD 97 million in 2017. Driven by the presence of several oil and gas manufacturing companies in the Kingdom, market size is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 3% to reach USD 121 million by 2025. The global gears market is dominated by spur gears and bevel gears, having 50-80% market share.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the wider regional market of the GCC. With many companies in the GCC establishing extraction and production plants, demand for gears in the region has been increasing and is expected to continue to increase from USD 106 million in 2017 to USD 151 million by 2025.The main focus of this opportunity is to establish a manufacturing facility for industrial gears.Manufacturing: establish outsourced services offering heat treatment, machining…Manufacturing: establish facilities to produce locally and supply manufacturing facilitiesHowever, additional opportunities for localization exist across the value chain of industrial gears production. These opportunities include:Design: potential to be part of a larger design center setup by the EPC or the OEMRaw materials: localize production of key materials such as PEEK, Delrin, brass, etc.Operations and maintenance: offer support services, including maintenance, installation and operation services

rows.title: Up-Scale Hotel Towers and Premium Commercial (Office) Towers – Dar Al Hijrah

details.description:
Description of Investment Opportunity
Rua Al Madinah Holding, a PIF company, is a key driver in developing infrastructure and assets that enhance Madinah’s position as a premier destination with a contemporary architectural landscape.

As part of this mandate, Rua Al Madinah Holding is offering investment opportunities in three upscale hotel towers and four upscale commercial towers, located within the Dar Al Hijrah project, a landmark mixed-use urban development in the holy city of Madinah, Saudi Arabia.

 

Deal Structure

Flexible deal structures are available, with multiple partnership models such as joint ventures, real estate funds, investment consortia and land or building leases

Assets Under Consideration

Hotel Towers (Shell & Core)

Opportunity 1: ~380 keys, BUA +40,300 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Opportunity 2: ~380 keys, BUA +40,300 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Opportunity 3: ~614 keys, BUA ≈70,000 sqm, 2 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Commercial (Office) Towers (Shell & Core)

Opportunity 4: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +10,650 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 5: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +9,500 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 6: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +13,380 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 7: BUA +56,300 sqm, land +8,850 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 16 floors
Investor Participation

Investors may participate in one or more of these opportunities

rows.title: Life sciences and healthcare sector opportunities

details.description:
An opportunity exists to establish local operations—manufacturing, assembly and service—to meet the growing demand for pharmaceuticals, medical devices and value-added healthcare services.

This opportunity targets local and international private-sector companies engaged in healthcare manufacturing or service provision that are willing to localize, including expanding capacity, upscaling and enhancing existing manufacturing capabilities in Saudi Arabia.

rows.title: Local Manufacturing of Cell and Gene Therapy Products

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of cell and gene therapy products to support advanced medical treatments through regenerative and personalized medicine solutions. The opportunity aims to meet rising demand for high-efficacy therapeutic interventions in complex and chronic conditions.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Enable access to next-generation, personalized treatments for chronic and genetic conditions.
• Strengthen domestic innovation and manufacturing in high-value, cell-based therapeutics.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising demand for regenerative medicine due to increased cases of cancer and genetic disorders. • Government initiatives promoting localization of advanced biotech and cell therapy platforms.

details.description: This opportunity involves setting up manufacturing facilities for biologic drugs in Saudi Arabia. Biologics are advanced therapies derived from living organisms, used to treat complex diseases such as cancer, autoimmune conditions, and rare disorders. Localizing production enhances healthcare innovation, quality of care, and biopharma sector competitiveness.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Accelerate the development of high-value biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
• Support healthcare innovation and access to advanced therapies.
• Reduce dependence on costly biologic imports.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising demand for biologics in oncology and autoimmune disease management. • Global shift toward precision medicine and advanced therapies. • Government support for high-tech pharma investment. • Strategic potential for regional leadership in biologics manufacturing.

rows.title: Production of Pharmaceutical Key Starting Materials (KSMs)

details.description: This opportunity seeks to localize the production of Key Starting Materials (KSMs), which are the essential building blocks in the production of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs). It is a foundational investment that strengthens the upstream pharmaceutical supply chain, reduces dependency on imports, and contributes to long-term national health security.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Strengthen the upstream pharmaceutical manufacturing value chain.
• Reduce reliance on global suppliers for critical raw materials.
• Promote local R&D and industrial innovation.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Growing demand for localized pharmaceutical input production. • Support from the government for industrial diversification and healthcare security. • Potential for vertical integration with API and drug product manufacturers. • Opportunity to attract global partnerships and advanced manufacturing technologies.

details.description: This opportunity aims to localize the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), which are the essential raw materials used to produce finished pharmaceutical products. The initiative supports national health security and aims to reduce dependency on imports while supporting Saudi Arabia’s growing pharmaceutical manufacturing capabilities.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Support localization of critical pharmaceutical inputs.
• Increase self-sufficiency and supply chain resilience.
• Strengthen the national pharmaceutical manufacturing ecosystem.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising demand for locally manufactured pharmaceutical products. • Government push for localization in the pharmaceutical sector. • Strategic alignment with Vision 2030 healthcare objectives. • Opportunities for technology transfer and partnerships with global API manufacturers.

rows.title: Manufacturing of Small Molecule Pharmaceutical Products

details.description: This opportunity involves establishing local manufacturing capabilities for small molecule pharmaceutical products in Saudi Arabia. These medicines form the backbone of primary care treatments for chronic and acute conditions and are currently heavily imported. The investment supports healthcare resilience and aligns with national priorities for local production.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Contribute to national drug security by reducing reliance on imports.
• Expand local industrial base and pharmaceutical ecosystem.
• Create high-value jobs and encourage knowledge transfer.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Increasing demand for chronic disease management. • Government incentives and regulatory support for localization. • Strong potential for regional exports and strategic partnerships with global pharmaceutical players. • Alignment with Vision 2030 to improve healthcare quality and access.

rows.title: Local Manufacturing of Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs)

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) devices to support effective diabetes and metabolic disorder management. Targeted products include CGM sensors, transmitters, and reader devices.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Enhance availability of critical glucose monitoring products to support chronic disease management.
• Develop AI-powered CGMs and wearable biosensors to position Saudi Arabia as a leader in advanced diabetes care.
• Foster integration with clinical and biotech R&D for localized innovation.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising demand for preventive healthcare and point-of-care diagnostics. • Growth of digital health and remote monitoring platforms increasing demand for real-time data-enabled CGMs. • Strategic opportunity to support local medical technology supply chains.

rows.title: Local Manufacturing of Medical Imaging Devices

details.description: Establish local manufacturing and remanufacturing of medical imaging devices supporting early diagnosis, treatment planning, and disease monitoring. Targeted products include MRI, CT, PET, SPECT, angiography, and cath lab equipment.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Enhance availability of critical imaging products by ensuring a stable local supply of medical imaging devices.
• Support ecosystem development by positioning Saudi Arabia as a regional MedTech hub with potential for OEM partnerships and exports.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Increasing demand for early and accurate diagnostics due to chronic diseases, cancer, and trauma cases. • Expansion of healthcare infrastructure and R&D institutions requiring high-quality imaging systems.

rows.title: Local Manufacturing of Ophthalmology & ENT Diagnostic Devices

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of ophthalmoscopes and related ophthalmology and ENT diagnostic devices used for retinal, optic nerve, and ENT examinations. Targeted products include ophthalmoscopes, tonometers, ENT units, keratometers, otoscopes, tympanometry equipment, and more.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Healthcare Self-Sufficiency: Reducing reliance on imported medical equipment strengthens domestic supply chains and emergency preparedness.
• Growth Potential: Positions Saudi Arabia for strategic OEM partnerships in optical devices and enables expansion of local manufacturing capabilities.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising cases of vision complications (e.g., glaucoma, cataracts, diabetic retinopathy) increasing demand for advanced eye diagnostic solutions. • Growing access to vision care services and awareness boosting demand for portable and reliable diagnostic tools.

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of ultrasound machines to meet Saudi Arabia’s growing demand for diagnostic imaging across primary, secondary, and specialized care. Targeted products include ultrasonic scanning apparatus, cardiovascular measurement devices, blood pressure monitors, and wearable ultrasound sensors.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Improve availability of non-invasive diagnostic care solutions, especially in maternal and emergency medicine.
• Support modular diagnostic tools for obstetrics, cardiology, internal medicine, and emergency care.
• Enable development of a MedTech manufacturing ecosystem with regional export potential.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • High demand for early detection and non-invasive diagnostics. • Rise of AI-driven imaging and compact ultrasound tech. • Strong alignment with digital health strategies and healthcare infrastructure expansion.

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of radiographic systems, supplying hospitals, diagnostic centers, and healthcare providers with advanced imaging and diagnostic equipment. Products include X-ray tubes, radiographic devices, parts, and accessories.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Enhance availability of critical imaging products by establishing a stable local supply of radiographic systems.
• Position Saudi Arabia as a MedTech manufacturing hub through regional exports and OEM partnerships.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising demand for diagnostic imaging due to increased chronic disease cases. • Expanding healthcare infrastructure including hospitals and research centers. • Growing need for cloud-connected, digital health diagnostic systems.

rows.title: Local Manufacturing of Laboratory and Hematology Reagents

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of laboratory and hematology reagents to support blood analysis, disease screening, and routine lab workflows. Target products include blood-grouping reagents, molecular diagnostic kits, and analyzers.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Ecosystem Enablement: Investments in laboratory reagents advance areas such as precision medicine and molecular diagnostics.
• Pharma & Life Sciences Spillover: Supports the development of vaccines and clinical diagnostics, reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position in the healthcare sector.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising demand for diagnostic testing in clinical labs and diagnostic centers. • Growing adoption of molecular diagnostics driving demand for specialized reagents.

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of intraocular lenses (IOLs), artificial ocular implants, and related components used in cataract and refractive eye surgeries to restore or correct vision. Targeted products include artificial eyes and customized optical implants.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Localize production of high-cost, high-precision equipment essential for cataract surgeries — among the most frequently performed procedures globally.
• Lay the foundation for innovation in advanced optics, including premium IOLs, presbyopia correction, and personalized lens designs.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Increasing investment in ophthalmology centers and surgical programs across Saudi Arabia. • Rising demand for vision correction devices driven by aging population and chronic eye conditions.

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of infusion pumps and systems, essential for delivering controlled doses of fluids, medications, and nutrients in hospitals, ICUs, and outpatient care. Targeted products include PCA (patient-controlled analgesia) pumps and insulin pumps.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Reduce reliance on imported infusion systems to strengthen domestic supply chains and improve emergency preparedness.
• Support local MedTech development and regional export expansion in high-tech infusion devices.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising demand for inpatient and ICU procedures including complex surgeries, cancer care, and intensive care operations. • National targets for increasing local content in strategic MedTech sectors. • Consistent demand across hospitals and outpatient facilities for advanced infusion systems.

rows.title: Local Manufacturing of Wound Management Products

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of wound care products used in acute, chronic, and post-surgical treatment settings. Targeted products include sterilized surgical plasters, medical dressings, and bandages not impregnated with pharmaceutical substances.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Increase local content across key MedTech areas aligned with KSA national targets.
• Support healthcare self-sufficiency and emergency preparedness through localized production.
• Reduce reliance on imported consumables by producing high-volume, repeat-use items.
• Unlock regional export potential for advanced wound care products.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • High turnover of consumables in hospitals and clinics ensures consistent demand. • Expansion of surgical procedures and chronic care treatments across the Kingdom.

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of mechanotherapy appliances to support physical therapy, rehabilitation, and musculoskeletal recovery treatments. Products include mechanotherapy machines, pneumatic compression devices, and therapeutic ultrasound devices.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Enhance healthcare self-sufficiency by reducing reliance on imported therapy equipment.
• Strengthen domestic supply chains and preparedness for public health demands.
• Enable modular, multi-use adoption across hospitals, physiotherapy centers, home care, and sports clinics.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising incidence of musculoskeletal and chronic pain conditions. • Expanding number of hospitals, wellness clinics, and fitness centers driving local demand for therapy devices.

rows.title: Manufacturing of Specialty Medical Chairs and Parts

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of specialty medical chairs and components, including examination, surgical, dialysis, and rehabilitation chairs for hospitals, clinics, and long-term care centers. Targeted products include dentist chairs with built-in dental equipment, surgical and rehab seating.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Enhance availability of critical products by supporting the healthcare sector and ensuring stable local supply of specialty chairs and parts.
• Enable ecosystem activation by unlocking OEM and supplier growth through demand for localized parts (e.g., motors, control arms, hydraulic systems, medical-grade textiles).

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising demand for customized chairs due to growth in clinics, surgical centers, and dialysis units. • Expansion of patient care infrastructure requiring procedure-specific seating systems.

rows.title: Local Manufacturing of Renal Care Devices

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of hemodialysis machines and dialyzers—critical components for renal care systems supporting patients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD). Targeted products include artificial kidney (dialysis) apparatus, dialyzers, peritoneal dialysis units, and CRRT systems.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Enhance availability of critical products and reduce long-term procurement costs.
• Strengthen national healthcare preparedness through local supply.
• Advance MedTech sector by positioning Saudi Arabia in precision mechatronics and patient monitoring technology.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • High and growing prevalence of chronic kidney disease (CKD) across the population. • Increased hospital and clinic capacity driving demand for renal care devices. • Rising burden of non-communicable diseases requiring long-term dialysis treatments.

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of orthopedic products to support both surgical and non-surgical treatments of musculoskeletal conditions. Targeted products include head and spine orthopedic appliances, artificial joints, prosthetics, bionics, and orthotics.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Localize high-cost, high-precision devices to enhance accessibility and cost efficiency.
• Reduce dependency on imported orthopedic devices by manufacturing domestically.
• Position Saudi Arabia as a MedTech hub for sophisticated orthopedic solutions with regional export potential.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising musculoskeletal conditions driving demand for artificial joints and trauma implants. • Vision 2030 initiatives pushing to increase local content across healthcare and MedTech sectors. • Growth in surgical infrastructure and rehabilitation services.

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of optical lenses—including spectacle lenses (glass and other materials)—to meet increasing demand across hospitals, clinics, and optical retailers. This opportunity aims to support both surgical and non-surgical vision care.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Increase accessibility to vision correction products and reduce dependency on imports.
• Strengthen supply chain resilience for high-volume eye care products.
• Enable modular use across hospitals, clinics, and retail markets.
• Support development of a domestic vision care ecosystem with potential for exports.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Growing incidence of myopia, cataracts, and presbyopia. • Rising demand for cosmetic and specialty lenses (e.g., astigmatism, keratoconus). • Push to localize high-volume consumer health products in Saudi Arabia.

rows.title: Local Manufacturing of Respiratory and Oxygen Therapy Devices

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of respiratory and oxygen therapy devices to support critical care and chronic disease management. This includes ventilators, CPAP, BiBAP, NO delivery systems, and devices for oxygen, ozone, and aerosol therapy. The opportunity targets hospitals, ICUs, emergency services, and home care environments.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Reduce reliance on imported medical equipment and build local manufacturing capacity.
• Strengthen national healthcare resilience, particularly for emergency and ICU settings.
• Support chronic respiratory disease management including asthma, COPD, and sleep apnea.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • High prevalence of respiratory conditions in the population. • Demand for modular and multi-purpose devices across different care settings. • Expansion of hospital infrastructure and critical care investments. • Potential for exports through regional medtech manufacturing leadership.

rows.title: Local Manufacturing of Minimally Invasive Devices & Tools

details.description: Establish local manufacturing for minimally invasive medical tools and devices such as disposable endoscopes, laparoscopic instruments, energy platforms, and associated consumables. strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Strengthen domestic healthcare self-sufficiency by reducing reliance on imported medical equipment.

• Position KSA as a MedTech manufacturing hub with regional export potential and partnerships with OEMs.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising demand from hospitals and surgical centers for minimally invasive procedures and tools. • National push to increase local content across strategic sectors, including MedTech. • Development of patient care devices as part of healthcare transformation goals.

rows.title: Assembly of Aviation Oil Lubricant Manufacturer

details.description:
Develop a Saudi-based aviation lubricant production facility to reduce reliance on imports.

 Partner with APSCO, ExxonMobil, and Aramco/Luberef to leverage global expertise and local manufacturing capabilities.

 Target a guaranteed domestic market (airlines, MROs, military aviation) and explore export opportunities in GCC & MENA.

 Enhance Saudi Arabia’s supply chain resilience by ensuring a stable, cost-effective lubricant supply.

Support Vision 2030 localization goals by reducing financial leakage and creating local jobs.

This Opportunity reduces financial leakage, enhances supply chain security, and creates a new industrial sector in Saudi Arabia. By localizing aviation lubricant production, this project can drive economic growth, reduce costs for airlines, and position Saudi Arabia as a regional hub for aviation lubricants.
Vision 2030 and the National Aviation Strategy set an ambitious target for the sector to grow from 100 Mn pax in 2019 to 330 Mn pax by 2030

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Currently there are no local assembly Aviation lubricant relying on international imports from one sources ( Exxon Mobile Texas plant)
• RTGs; potential to replace KSA imports

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: Cost Efficiency – Reduce import costs, shipping fees, and foreign currency risks. Operational Security – Ensure uninterrupted lubricant availability for commercial & military aviation. Economic Impact – Create local jobs, develop industrial expertise, and drive investment. Supply Chain Optimization – Eliminate logistics bottlenecks & price volatility. Sustainability & ESG Alignment – Support green aviation initiatives with localized, optimized production. KSA aviation sector to grow from 100Mn pax in 2019 to 330 Mn pax by 2030 KSA airlines’ fleet to grow from 250 aircrafts to 500 aircrafts Substantial regional demand from a strong aviation sector  Active players (non-exhaustive): International players: Exxon Mobile, Local Players: Apsco – Lubref/Aramco

rows.title: Adventure And Water Sport Activity Supplyer

details.description:
OPDC is seeking private sector investment and operational expertise to either JV or develop and manage a comprehensive range of water sports activities at THE RIG Project, a flagship tourism destination in Saudi Arabia. This opportunity allows private operators to provide services and equipment for various water sports while partnering with OPDC under a rent plus profit-sharing model. 

Products/services covered
- The opportunity targets a wide range of water sports and related services, including but not limited to:
- Adventure Water Sports: Kite surfing, surfing, jet skiing, e-foil rides, and motorized water sports.
- Recreational Water Sports: Diving, parasailing, snorkeling, and stand-up paddle boarding.
- Training Services: Professional lessons and certification for water sports enthusiasts.
- Rental Services: Equipment rentals for guests interested in independent water sport activities.
 
Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Upstream
- Investment in equipment and materials for water sports (e.g., jet skis, diving equipment, kite-boards).
- Recruitment and training of skilled personnel for operations and guest safety.
- Setting up operational hubs and storage facilities at “THE RIG”.

Midstream
- Service delivery, including providing water sports experiences, training, and rentals.
- Integration with “THE RIG’s” broader tourism offerings to enhance guest experiences.
- Adherence to OPDC’s standards for sustainability and safety.

Focus Area
- The opportunity is focused on offering a world-class, diverse water sports experience that complements the luxury tourism offerings at "THE RIG"

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• A unique opportunity to partner with a global tourism icon, a luxury, adventure-focused environment and become a vital part of the region's tourism evolution.
• OPDC is offering a lucrative rent plus profit-sharing model, enabling private sector players to generate consistent revenue without the need for significant upfront infrastructure investment.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia Adventure Tourism Market: Growing at 8-12% YoY. - GCC Water Sports Market: Growing at 6-8% YoY.  Mega Projects Boom – Government support tourism - High Demand for Experiences - Tourists are shifting towards unique, adrenaline-filled activities, creating demand for water sports such as kite surfing, e-foil, parasailing, and diving.

details.description:
The Rua Al Haram development project presents a strategic investment opportunity for private investors to participate in the design, construction, and operation of logistics and labor accommodation facilities critical to the success of this large-scale, multi-phase development. These facilities will play a pivotal role in supporting the project's construction and operational activities, addressing workforce housing, material handling, and overall construction logistics.

Based on the current forecast (subject to change) of daily labor personnel numbers, the labor accommodation would have the following key characteristics:

- Land  – The land required is based upon 3-story residential buildings = 300m.sq x 600m.sq = 180,000 m.sq land area.
- Capacity required – The employee residential facilities would be required for ~ 5,000 employees consisting of:
      - 1 Bedroom (40 sq. m per room) – 8
      - 1 Bedroom (20m.sq per room) – 112
      - 2 Bed per room (20m.sq per room) – 280
      - 4 beds per room (24m.sq per room) – 1080

- Additional facilities include kitchens, dining, recreation, sport, laundry, admin, security, medical, retail, fire station, swimming pools, parking, and utilities. Additionally, other facilities, such as - compounds for contractors, consultants' offices, warehouses, off-site manufacturing, etc. (typically requiring ∼1,500 m.sq. for 200 people.

This opportunity targets essential infrastructure and operational services, including worker housing, transportation, material storage, batching plants, construction logistics, and security systems. These offerings are critical to supporting the smooth execution of the Rua Al Haram project and ensuring its timely delivery. They also create long-term value for investors through sustained demand and operational scalability.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• This opportunity offers strategic alignment with national priorities, financially lucrative revenue streams, and the chance to play a central role in one of the region's most significant urban development projects. By addressing critical project needs for logistics and labor accommodations, investors can secure a high-impact, low-risk position in a transformative initiative with long-term growth potential.
• The strategic benefits of this opportunity are rooted in the scale and complexity of the Rua Al Haram project, regional development priorities under Vision 2030, and technological and operational advancements that enhance efficiency and scalability. These benefits ensure sustained demand, long-term profitability, and expansion opportunities.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Rua Al Haram represents the region's unparalleled urban development initiative, setting a new benchmark for scale and ambition. Its portfolio comprises of hotel guest rooms, residential units, commercial space, and prayer areas. - The project is expected to require a workforce of significant scale, reaching over 100,000 workers at peak construction.

rows.title: Pumped Hydro Storage (PHS) N1 at NEOM

details.description:
Description of Investment Opportunity
NEOM aims to become the world’s first 100% renewable electricity system with energy generation based mainly on solar. Energy storage is required to store excess solar energy during the day and release it at night. Pumped Hydro Storage (PHS) is the most mature and cost competitive storage available. Waterways and powerhouse to be located completely underground to improve land conservation, durability and aesthetics.

 

Deal Structure:
The project is envisioned to be structured as a Build–Own–Operate–Transfer (“BOOT”) in accordance with best industry practices
Time schedule assumes commercial and financial close in Q3 2025 and first energy in Q4 2029

Technical Considerations: 
- Installed capacity  – 2.2 GW
- Generation max power – 2.1 GW
- Storage capacity – 23.1 GWh
- Time constant in turbine mode – 11 hours
- Round trip efficiency – 80%

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• PHS shall become an iconic piece of energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia
• Robust contractual structure in line with best international practices
• Stable and predictable cash-flows, credit support and risk allocation will ensure bankability of the project

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - NEOM aims to create the world’s first 100% renewable energy system, underpinning demand for long-term energy storage. PHS will be the first of several PHS facilities at NEOM

details.description:
Jeddah Central Development Company is seeking a qualified private sector investor interested in partnering to finance the Oceanarium. The company is exploring different private sector participants.

A world-class oceanarium and coral farm, as well as a maritime research hub, situated along the coastal area of Jeddah. Designed by SOM from the United States the facility will feature seven pavilions (Shoreline and Mangrove, Coral Reef, The Vortex, Depth of the Red Sea, Back to the Shore, Restoration & Production of a Reef, and Technology & Products from the Red Sea) aimed at enhancing visitors' experience. The total land area is 43,924 m2, total Gross Floor Area (GFA) is nearly 21,076 m2, with an average capacity of 2,500 persons. 

The Oceanarium is situated at the Jeddah Center destination project, the heart of Jeddah, Saudi Arabia’s second-largest city, and gateway to Mekkah. Spanning an impressive 5.7 million m2, with 9.5 km of coastline. Jeddah Central is set to become a global waterfront destination with extensive mixed-use assets, including hospitality, retail, commercial, and residential properties, and key landmarks. The project is positioned as a leading tourist destination, aiming to preserve Jeddah’s rich culture while revitalizing the downtown area.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Investing in an income-generating asset under a PPP structure.
• Playing a part in financing an environment-friendly—including promoting biodiversity—a social asset with a positive social and environmental impact.
• Diversifying the investment portfolio.
• Fostering trust and collaboration with a leading PIF-owned portfolio company.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

cardsData.stat:

[For a facility of 6M sqm per year; excluding land cost]

• Opportunity to fill a gap in local supply chain as currently, no local players involved in cutting marble blocks to slabs
• Opportunity to gain a competitive edge as locally cut slabs of premium marble blocks imported from countries such as Italy and Spain will be more price competitive than slabs imported from the same countries
• Large facility with significant volumes will help achieve attractive EBITDA margins of 18-25% and rapid payback
• Current Market
• Characteristics
• Consolidated market with five local suppliers serving ~85% of the market; only slab cutting, and installation step is localized in Saudi Arabia
• All marble demand is met through imports because Saudi Arabia has limited marble reserves
• Oman, Italy, Egypt, and China account for more than two-thirds of the imports to Saudi Arabia
• All local players currently import marble in the form of slabs

details.description:
OPDC's THE RIG. project offers an opportunity for the private sector to propose innovative and sustainable mass mobility solutions for transporting visitors from onshore terminals to THE RIG. destination. This project spans 30 years, with the possibility of the operating model being based on a long-term lease or an operational management model.

The focus is on offering safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions, including options such as electric, hybrid, and cutting-edge technologies like sea gliders or hovercraft.

Products/services covered
The primary services targeted by this opportunity are transportation and mobility solutions for visitors. The focus is on providing a mass transit system that ensures safe, efficient, and comfortable transportation between onshore terminals and offshore on THE RIG. destination. The products or services could include
 - Electric or hybrid-powered transport options.
- Innovative transportation technologies (e.g., sea gliders, hovercraft).
- Long-term operational leasing or management services.
- Maintenance and safety assurance services for transportation solutions.
 
Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Design and Development
- The development and design of transportation solutions (e.g., electric/hybrid vehicles, sea gliders, hovercraft).

Manufacturing
- The production of transportation solutions, including any customization needed for offshore travel.

Operations
- Managing the transportation of visitors on a daily basis, including crew operations, maintenance, and safety management.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Tourism Development
• The project enhances the tourism sector, contributing to KSA’s ambition to become a leading global tourist destination. THE RIG project will likely attract significant numbers of international visitors, making efficient mass mobility solutions essential.

• The opportunity allows for the integration of cutting-edge mobility technologies such as sea gliders and hovercraft, reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a leader in innovative and advanced transport systems.

• With a 30-year span and the potential for long-term leases or operation models, the project offers significant financial returns, making it an attractive investment for the private sector.

details.description:
Badael is a pioneer in enhancing the quality of life through innovative and sustainable solutions. Committed to Saudi Vision 2030, Badael is dedicated to helping one million Saudis quit smoking by 2028.

To support this mission, Badael has launched its flagship product, DZRT, nicotine pouches that offer a less harmful, tobacco-free alternative to help individuals quit smoking.

An opportunity exists to establish a local manufacturing facility for pure nicotine, which would supply both Badael and global markets.

Application
Pure nicotine serves as the core active ingredient in nicotine pouches, delivering a controlled nicotine dose to satisfy cravings without the harmful chemicals found in traditional tobacco products.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Enhanced focus on Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Tobacco Control Strategy, aimed at improving the quality of life by promoting a smoke-free environment.
• Gain access to the largest market in the Middle East, with a rapidly growing population projected to reach 39.7 million by 2030.
• Limited local supply and the potential to export to regional markets.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The global nicotine pouch market is valued at $3.95 billion and is expected to reach $22.95 billion, registering a CAGR of 34.4%. - In Saudi Arabia, the market is currently valued at SAR 900 million and is expected to grow at a CAGR of 30%.
